name: bto-cv
description: Convert supplied CVs into BTO-branded HTML using the maintained company template.

interface.shortDescription: Create BTO-branded CVs from supplied candidate information.
defaultPrompt: Convert the attached CV into BTO HTML format using the latest template.
Create a fictional BTO CV to test the template and print layout.
interface.longDescription: Convert supplied Word, PDF or text CVs into BTO-branded HTML. Retrieves the maintained template when GitHub access is available, preserves supplied facts, and supports editing and printing in a browser.
